title.en: Open Community and Nearby AI learning while fixing responsive learning headlines
title.zh: 开放社区与 Nearby AI 学习并修复学习页响应式标题

purpose.en: Let every visitor see SmartLingo's learning community and practice immediately with clearly disclosed AI classmates, while keeping real-member contact and every community mutation behind sign-in and making key learning headlines fit desktop, iPad, and phone screens cleanly.
purpose.zh: 让每位访客都能浏览 SmartLingo 学习社区并立即与明确标注的 AI 同学练习，同时继续把真人联系与所有社区写入操作置于登录边界内，并让关键学习标题在桌面、iPad 与手机上整齐适配。

en: Make Community a public-read destination instead of redirecting anonymous visitors to sign-in; public topics, replies, meeting summaries, colleges, rankings, and AI partners remain visible.
Give anonymous visitors three clearly labeled AI learning partners and a 12-language practice selector, with direct access to the existing public assistant experience.
Keep real-member Nearby, member search, posting, replying, meeting scheduling, meeting joining, blocking, and reporting gated by sign-in; public meeting payloads never expose private thread IDs.
Repair homepage, SmartCard, and Community headline sizing and wrapping so iPad-width screens no longer isolate the final Chinese character or overflow the viewport.
zh: 把社区改为公开只读目的地，匿名访客不再被重定向登录；公开主题、回复、学习会摘要、学院、排行榜与 AI 学伴均可浏览。
为匿名访客提供三个明确标注的 AI 学伴及 12 种练习语言选择，并直接进入现有公开 AI 助手体验。
真人 Nearby、成员搜索、发帖、回复、安排或加入学习会、屏蔽和举报仍要求登录；公开学习会数据不会暴露私密会话 ID。
修复首页、SmartCard 与社区标题的字号和换行，使 iPad 宽度不再出现末尾中文单字孤行，也不会产生横向溢出。

en: SmartLingo Community page and public-read APIs, Nearby AI entry, community meetings, homepage social heading, SmartCard heading, and their contract tests.

The release is isolated to smartlingo.net and does not change Clerk configuration, signed-in learning progress, payments, college economics, Cloudflare resource boundaries, sibling sites, or external credentials.
zh: 影响 SmartLingo 社区页面与公开只读 API、Nearby AI 入口、社区学习会、首页社交标题、SmartCard 标题及其契约测试。
本次发布仅限 smartlingo.net，不修改 Clerk 配置、登录用户学习进度、支付、学院经济模型、Cloudflare 资源边界、兄弟站点或外部凭据。

en: Split Community access into a public read path and authenticated interaction path; server-side POST handlers remain protected even if a client attempts to bypass the UI.
Prevent anonymous Community from requesting the real-member Nearby endpoint, while making AI partner cards and target-language selection available without location, profile, or cookie sharing.
Return public topics and meeting summaries with anonymous viewer metadata; omit member directories for anonymous visitors and blank private meeting thread IDs.
Use bounded responsive typography, natural line wrapping, full-width heading containers, and phone/iPad/desktop layout rules without adding horizontal scrolling.
No D1 migration is required for this release.
zh: 把社区访问拆分为公开读取与登录互动两条路径；即使客户端绕过界面，服务端 POST 写入仍受认证保护。
匿名社区不会请求真人 Nearby 接口；AI 学伴卡片和目标语言选择无需位置、个人资料或跨功能 Cookie 即可使用。
公开返回主题与学习会摘要并标记匿名查看者；匿名访客不获取成员目录，私密学习会 thread ID 会被清空。
采用有界响应式字号、自然换行、全宽标题容器与手机、iPad、桌面布局规则，且不引入横向滚动。
本次发布不需要 D1 迁移。

en: All 366 repository tests pass, including the new public-read/authenticated-write Community boundary, anonymous AI Nearby, private meeting IDs, protected navigation, and responsive headline contracts.
The production vinext build, TypeScript, changed-file ESLint with zero errors, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, whitespace validation, and shared site-policy gates pass.

Browser testing covers anonymous Community navigation and refresh, the 12-language AI selector, AI assistant entry, homepage and SmartCard headings, Chinese and English, and five phone, iPad, laptop, and desktop viewports with zero horizontal overflow.
zh: 仓库 366 项测试全部通过，覆盖新增的社区公开读取／登录写入边界、匿名 AI Nearby、私密学习会 ID、受保护导航及响应式标题契约。
生产 vinext 构建、TypeScript、修改文件 ESLint 零错误、敏感信息扫描、产物验证、空白校验及共享站点策略门禁全部通过。
浏览器验证覆盖匿名进入与刷新社区、12 种语言 AI 选择器、AI 助手入口、首页与 SmartCard 标题、中英双语及五种手机、iPad、笔记本和桌面视口，横向溢出为零。

en: Anonymous visitors can learn with AI and read public community material, but must sign in before contacting a real member or changing community state; this is an intentional safety boundary rather than missing functionality.
Scheduled and release QA do not enable real-member Nearby, create posts, send messages, or schedule meetings.
zh: 匿名访客可与 AI 学习并阅读公开社区内容，但联系真人或改变社区状态前必须登录；这是有意设置的安全边界，而非功能缺失。
定时与发布 QA 不会开启真人 Nearby、创建帖子、发送消息或安排学习会。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's 12 interface languages, 21-day learning paths, anonymous feature-scoped progress, signed-in D1 progress, AI disclosure, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery.
Community is useful before sign-in through public educational content and AI practice, while human social features continue to follow consent, privacy, and abuse-control requirements.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 的 12 种界面语言、21 天学习路径、匿名功能级进度、登录用户 D1 进度、AI 身份披露及 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布流程。
社区在登录前即可通过公开教育内容与 AI 练习产生价值；真人社交功能继续遵守同意、隐私与滥用控制要求。
